text: The same g-C3N4 catalyst was applied to Rhodamine B (RhB) removal under visible light, but the kinetics rather than the endpoint efficiency were the focus of this study.
Experiments were carried out with an initial RhB concentration of 15 mg/L and a catalyst dosage of 1 g/L under a 300 W xenon lamp with a 420 nm cutoff filter.
The degradation followed pseudo-first-order kinetics according to ln(C0/Ct) = kt, giving a rate constant k = 0.031 min⁻¹ over the first 60 min of irradiation (R² = 0.98).
